_source: Office of the Chief Electoral Officer, Karnataka — press conference by CEO on SIR-2026, 12.08.2026. Statewide ASDDO totals corroborated across ThePrint, Siasat, The Hans India, Bhatkallys and NewKerala (all report 1.11 crore / 20.03% of the electorate). Official ASDDO list: ceo.karnataka.gov.in/asddo.html.
_note: The CEO's own count of electors marked ASDDO/UEF. Independent of the booth PDFs, so it is the only external check on whether the import is complete. State totals are the 12.08 figures (11,104,705 = 20.03% of the unchanged 55,432,314 electorate — the ratio is exact, which is why the electorate is carried forward). Per-district figures: the 10 largest districts below were re-transcribed from the 12.08 press coverage (_districtsAsOf 2026-08-12); the remaining 24 are still as-on 2026-08-10 (_districtsAsOf24 2026-08-10) — the 12.08 district-wise table exists in the press-release images but only the 10 named districts were published in text. Day-over-day district drift is under 0.2%, and only the state totals are shipped to the dashboard. Update this whenever a newer press release is published, and re-run scripts/reconcile.mjs.
